notes: Variant assumption entered as alternating walking lunges with two dumbbells held at the sides. Exact continuous alternating two-dumbbell walking-lunge evidence remains limited: the most exact walking-lunge papers used dumbbell carrying-position variations and 5RM conditions, while the strongest bilateral-dumbbell EMG study used forward lunges with a stride and push-back reset. Gluteus medius is classified as support, not primary, because high activation is interpreted mainly as pelvic/frontal-plane control. Shared data/anatomy.json contains local mesh mappings for every visible role in this movement, including trunk stabilizers mapped to the erector-spinae mesh set.
